decisions.decision: The Commission will redraft another version of the Fitchburg IMA based on these discussions and track changes on future drafts.
decisions.quote: commission will redraft another version of the ima based upon these discussions and will track the changes on future drafts.

decisions.decision: The Sewer Commission would like Selectmen involved in the IMA negotiations, and Kerry if that is what is determined.
decisions.quote: the sewer commission would like to have selectmen involved with the negotiations as well as kerry if that is what is determined.

decisions.decision: The Sewer Commission would like discussions with Leominster on accepting additional flow or future connections from Lunenburg, and additional informal discussions with Fitchburg.
decisions.quote: they would also like to have discussions with leominster with regards to their acceptance of additional flow or future connections from lunenburg

decisions.decision: Suggested that the negotiating committee be two Sewer Commission members, two Selectmen and Kerry, so three could attend sessions with two alternates.
decisions.quote: it was suggested that the committee be comprised of two members of the sewer commission, two selectmen and kerry.
